name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
summary: Direct income support to landholding farmer families, paid straight into the bank account.

benefits.headline: ₹6,000 per year per family
details: Paid in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000, roughly every four months, directly to your bank account (DBT).
One benefit per farmer family (husband, wife and minor children count as one family).

summary: Your family owns cultivable land (land record in your family's name).
The land was owned (or inherited) on or before 1 February 2019, the scheme's cut-off date.

None of the exclusion categories apply to you or your family: income tax payer in the last assessment year, serving or retired government officer/employee (not Multi-Tasking Staff/Class IV/Group D), pensioner drawing ₹10,000 or more per month, holder of a constitutional post, or a registered professional such as a doctor, engineer, lawyer, CA or architect.
Aadhaar-linked bank account, completed eKYC and (as now being required) a Farmer ID.

rules.label: You have farmland
rules.pass_text: You have farmland registered in KisanAI.
rules.fail_text: PM-KISAN is only for landholding farmer families.
rules.unknown_text: Add your farm details so we can check this.

rules.label: Land is owned by your family (not leased)
rules.pass_text: You cultivate land owned by your family.
rules.fail_text: Tenant farmers and sharecroppers are not covered, because land ownership is the basic condition.
rules.unknown_text: Tell us whether the land is owned or leased.

rules.label: Land owned (or inherited) on or before 1 Feb 2019
rules.pass_text: Your family held this land by the 1 Feb 2019 cut-off.
rules.fail_text: Land bought after 1 Feb 2019 is generally outside the cut-off. Inherited land may still qualify; ask your Agriculture/revenue office.
rules.unknown_text: Tell us whether your family owned this land on 1 Feb 2019.

rules.label: No income tax paid by the family in the last assessment year
rules.pass_text: No income tax payer in your family.
rules.fail_text: Families that paid income tax in the last assessment year are excluded.
rules.unknown_text: Tell us whether anyone in your family pays income tax.

rules.label: No serving/retired government employee or pensioner (≥ ₹10,000/month) in the family
rules.pass_text: No excluded government employee or pensioner in your family.
rules.fail_text: Families with serving or retired government officers/employees, or pensioners drawing ₹10,000+ a month, are excluded. Multi-Tasking Staff, Class IV and Group D staff are exempt from this exclusion.
rules.unknown_text: Tell us about government employment or pension in your family.

rules.label: No current/former constitutional post holder in the family
rules.pass_text: No constitutional post holder in your family.
rules.fail_text: Families with a current or former holder of a constitutional post (for example Minister, MP, MLA, Mayor) are excluded.
rules.unknown_text: Tell us whether anyone in your family holds or held such a post.

rules.label: No registered professional practising in the family
rules.pass_text: No registered professional in your family.
rules.fail_text: Registered professionals practising as doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants or architects are excluded.
rules.unknown_text: Tell us whether anyone in your family practises one of these professions.

rules.label: Aadhaar card
rules.fail_text: Get an Aadhaar card first. eKYC through Aadhaar is mandatory.
rules.unknown_text: Tell us whether you have Aadhaar.

rules.label: Bank account linked to Aadhaar
rules.pass_text: Your bank account is linked to Aadhaar.
rules.fail_text: Link your bank account to Aadhaar (ask your bank branch) so payments can reach you.
rules.unknown_text: Tell us whether your bank account is linked to Aadhaar.

rules.label: Farmer ID (Farmer Registry / AgriStack)
rules.fail_text: Get your Farmer ID under the Farmer Registry (AgriStack). It has been reported as required to keep receiving PM-KISAN installments; confirm at your nearest CSC or Agriculture office.
rules.unknown_text: Tell us whether you have registered for a Farmer ID.

verify: Your State/UT government verifies your land records before payments start.
If another family member already receives PM-KISAN, your family cannot claim a second benefit.

documents.name: Aadhaar card
documents.note: eKYC is mandatory for all registered farmers.

documents.name: Land ownership record (khasra / khatauni / jamabandi / record of rights, as named in your state)
documents.note: Must show the land in your family's name.

documents.name: Bank account number and IFSC code
documents.note: The account should be linked to Aadhaar so payments can be credited.

documents.name: Farmer ID (Farmer Registry / AgriStack)
documents.note: Increasingly required for installments; it links your land records to schemes.

steps: Open pmkisan.gov.in, go to Farmers Corner and choose New Farmer Registration (or visit a Common Service Centre).
Enter Aadhaar, mobile number and state, then fill in land and bank details.
Complete eKYC: OTP-based on the portal/app, or biometric at a CSC.
Your state government verifies the land records and approves the application.
Check Beneficiary Status / Know Your Status on the portal to track installments.
offline: Local Agriculture department / block office or the village revenue official (patwari/lekhpal) who handles land records

deadline.text: No last date to register; registration is open throughout the year. Installments are released every four months, so finish eKYC before the next one. Installments are paid only to farmers whose eKYC is complete.

caveats: Exclusion rules apply to the whole family. Please answer the family questions for your household, not just yourself.
